source_metadata.scope: Only policy rate and Gwangjin apartment sales-price index; no mortgage-rate, school, station or supply features.

policy_rate.method: Official public rate-change table; month-end last effective rate, not a monthly average.
policy_rate.availability_rule: Month-end rate is conservatively usable from the first day of the following month.
policy_rate.historical_regime_note: Until February 2008 the official history refers to the overnight call-rate target; from March 2008 the BOK base rate.

gwangjin_apt_index.series_type: Monthly apartment sale price survey index, raw/unadjusted series; not transaction-price index.
gwangjin_apt_index.availability_rule: Historical months: assumed next-month 15th from official monthly release schedule. Latest available snapshot: observed official post date.
gwangjin_apt_index.publication_date_limitation: Historical actual release dates were not individually retrieved; downstream model joins as of the first day of each anchor month; release dates may differ from the assumed next-month day 15.
gwangjin_apt_index.vintage_limitation: Latest official historical series downloaded in 2026, including any historical revisions/rebasing. Not a point-in-time vintage archive.
